name: Marcus Vance
comment: An extraordinary culinary symphony. The Wagyu Filet Mignon melts on the tongue, and the service achieves perfection without pretense.

name: Sophia Reynolds
comment: L'Étoile redefines modern French fine dining. Every dish is a canvas of vibrant flavor and immaculate artistic balance.

name: David Sterling
comment: Celebrated our 10th anniversary here. The private dining atmosphere, sommelier's pairings, and warm hospitality made it unforgettable.
